storm.definition: max drawdown ≥ 50% within 7 days of the anchor close

breakout.definition: max run-up ≥ +30% within 7 days of the anchor close

notes: Features are the ones Nansen serves point in time (historical screener + prior candles). The live Storm Score also uses holders and insider clusters, which have no point-in-time endpoint; so this tests the Storm logic on its flow, liquidity and volatility signals, not every input.
Time split: trained on the three older anchors, tested on the newest. Samples within an anchor share market conditions, so the test set is one market regime.
Stablecoins and native/wrapped gas tokens are excluded.
Nansen's historical screener returned no rows for sui, tron, so those chains (and Tier B) are untested here.
